effective_model: One light radial mode, canonical invariant distance, f=v, a positive locally matched GW curvature. Higher derivatives, particle thresholds and electroweak/beam corrections must be negligible or independently subtracted before using pole or scattering quantities.
source: Exclusive spin-zero muon-pair current at tree level and at first order in calibrated y_mu. CP even real local 3h and 4h. Double and triple muon-Higgs contacts zero in the baseline. Optional additional real contact d produces d*(s/m_h^2-1) in the reduced three-body amplitude.
